'''Myntors''' were quadrupedal [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] native to [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. Myntors resided in [[Arblis Forest]] and (along with other predators) contributed to the [[extinction]] of [[Extinct bird species|a native bird species]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

They had bulky body covered with [[Bone/Legends|bony]] back plates, stubby clawed legs, long snouts, protruding and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] on stalks that could poke around the head to see objects. Their plates were capable of deflecting [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts.<ref name="guide" />

Myntors would typically use their claws to dig large holes into the ground and bury themsleves inside to camouflage, while spying around with their protruding eyes; when a prey approached, they seized it with their jaws.<ref name="guide" />
